title: Free Night Awards Season Matrix for Nights Rebooked With a Returned Award
content:
When one of the Free Night Awards that came back from a cancelled stay is applied to a night of another Reward Night Rate reservation, the season recorded on the new reservation moves the rebooked night's price: a peak night costs one season step more than the standard-season price, an off-peak night one season step less, and a standard night the standard-season price itself. A category's season step is the gap between its neighbouring seasons on the Ashbury Rewards award chart.

The season is the award season recorded on the new reservation's Room Reservations record, and the category is that reservation's award category.

| Award categories | Season step (points) |
|---|---|
| 1 to 3 | 2500 |
| 4 to 6 | 5000 |
| 7 | 10000 |
| 8 | 15000 |

## Matrix

| Category | Off-peak night | Standard night | Peak night |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1, 2 or 3 | Standard-season price less 2500 | Standard-season price | Standard-season price plus 2500 |
| 4, 5 or 6 | Standard-season price less 5000 | Standard-season price | Standard-season price plus 5000 |
| 7 | Standard-season price less 10000 | Standard-season price | Standard-season price plus 10000 |
| 8 | Standard-season price less 15000 | Standard-season price | Standard-season price plus 15000 |
